answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the comet graph. Re-attestations are stored in nebula and ledge lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 609 impostors cost 1607 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
